games.title: CRASH
games.pitch: dodge the tasks, drink the coffee, don't get cooked.

games.title: tab hoarder
games.pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. overhang gets cut. miss once and you're cooked.

games.title: bellchain
games.pitch: hit one bell, it hits the next one. you are now a bell manager.
games.controls: tap or click a bell to ring it. space rings a random bell, m mutes. tap upgrades to buy them.

games.title: Handbag Havoc
games.pitch: granny on a mobility scooter bowls garden gnomes into each other with her purse. it's self-defence.
games.controls: wasd / arrows or drag anywhere to steer. 1 2 3 to pick upgrades. r restart, p pause, m mute.

games.title: fathom
games.pitch: submarine duel where every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie. so will you.
games.controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate.
